notes.title: Performance Update
notes.notes:
Hey everybody ! 
Here is a small (but impactful) update ! 

[h2]Updated:[/h2]
General performance improvements. You should have generally more fps (around 20%) especially in medium and high settings.

[h2]Fixed:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Random Fatal Error that prevented the game to launch
[*] Quest not randomly starting causing bugs
[/list]

We hope you will appreciate it ! 

Until next time.

notes.title: Demo Update 0.16
notes.notes:
We have been working hard to improve the demo these pasts weeks ! 
As usual keep in mind that these elements will keep on being improved in the coming weeks.

[h2]IN-GAME MECHANICS[/h2]

[h3]Addition of quests[/h3] 
(quests allow you to earn bonus points and tiles).

[list]
[*] Road quests.
[*] Canal quests.
[/list]

[h3]Addition of features [/h3]
Features are given randomly during the game.

[list]
[*] Feature refresh (allows you to reload the current tile, replacing it with a new one).
[*] Feature generate (allows you to generate an ideal tile for the placement chosen by the player).
[/list]

[h2]MENUS[/h2]
Addition of the "help" menu, which contains the basic explanations of the game (work in progress).

[h2]SOUND DESIGN[/h2]
We have improved the sound feedback of various elements in the game such as an incremential sound effect for the points rewards.

We hope you will like it ! 
The Way16a team.
